authority.summary: The user is broadly satisfied with the current UI and requests focused improvement: partial mana automation, trigger handling through Feed, hidden activated-ability access, and responsive Japanese prose interrupt the core solo-play loop. This is not authority for a full redesign.
authority.priorityBasis: docs/judge-protocol.md section 2: MyDeck/direct play friction is the highest selection signal

appliedEntries.note: Top priority: complete MyDeck mana-source inventory and integrate all CR-modeled activated mana ability plans into cast auto-payment; no silently omitted source and no fake-auto.
Unify PrimaryAction and ArrowUp, place simple triggers directly, use a dedicated trigger-order/choice surface for nontrivial cases, and remove Feed as a mandatory action hop.
Make the battlefield click a CR-aware smart tap when exactly one modeled tap ability exists; show an inline picker when ambiguous; retain manual tap in the full action sheet.

Use icon-first repeated actions, icon plus 2-4 kanji for unfamiliar or consequential actions, and move prose to progressive disclosure. Verify 375 portrait, 812 landscape, and 1440 desktop with no overflow.

constraints: Applied to cr-backbone-ledger.json under the user's explicit 2026-07-18 exception for ledger editing while the Claude judge lacks tokens.
The user owns this priority order; the returning judge owns contract changes, reviewer tests, and independent revalidation of these unreviewed entries.
ACT-3 and ACT-4 remain pending after this cohort; they are not deleted.
Responsive icon work is a cross-cutting acceptance constraint, not a standalone visual-polish diversion.
